name: regatta
description: Regatta: an open-source Business-as-Code framework, one installable plugin per module.

plugins.name: regatta
plugins.description: The core every module builds on: shared library, model gate, cost, secrets, the regatta CLI.

plugins.name: atlas
plugins.description: Knowledge with three lifecycles: the bulletin (/share), promotion (/promote), the vault commit, the docs map and routines kept in git.

plugins.name: helloworld
plugins.description: The public door: name-check and /name to name a project, helloworld to publish it through a privacy scan.

plugins.name: wharf
plugins.description: One session, one worktree: the checkpoint hook and its lock, the landing (/finish, /evacuate, /todo), the review gate and the pull request tool, the repo registry's tools, session forks and status, and seven agents.

plugins.name: wharf-runs
plugins.description: Unattended runs across a fleet of Macs: dispatch a seeded branch now, later or on another Mac; the lander that finishes idle branches; pickup and move between Macs; one harness over Claude Code, Codex and Orca, and hail to reach a live session; Orca kept to the registry's scopes.

plugins.name: plumb
plugins.description: Measure: model usage and cost, interruptions, the tier hint and the owner's own time per project.

plugins.name: sextant
plugins.description: Strategy towards your North Star; today its ideas intake, Sparks: voice memos, written notes and Apple Notes in, one note per idea out.

plugins.name: lighthouse
plugins.description: Upkeep of the machines: a health pass, declared settings, several logins, shared-drive publishing, folder trust, tiling, and the guards around secrets and logins.

plugins.name: aurora
plugins.description: Aurora Borealis, the night job: the weekly loop's branches, charts and dream sections, and /embark, the Monday sitting.

plugins.name: keel
plugins.description: Decisions batched in one doc, answered inline and taken back as commits: the D-list, its form and page, the Stop-hook reply lint, the session gate.

plugins.name: helm
plugins.description: Project management: a large idea broken into ships, blocks and tasks; the skippers and their tick, the asks an unattended run relays instead of asking, and the board.
